card: Adds test coverage for out-of-range address timestamp handling in P2P address message processing. Currently, the branches in net_processing that clamp timestamps that are too old or too far in the future to five days ago lack dedicated test coverage. The author demonstrates importance via mutation testing, showing that the added tests kill two mutants in net_processing.cpp.
evidence: PR description demonstrates that the added test kills two specific mutation testing mutants in net_processing.cpp that replace the respective boundary checks with false.
problem: The logic in net_processing that clamps addr messages with timestamps that are either excessively old or too far in the future to five days in the past lacks explicit test coverage, leaving the branches vulnerable to regressions.

risk.why: Touches only test code to verify address timestamp clamping.

summary: Adds test coverage for handling out-of-range address timestamps in P2P address processing. It tests that addresses received with timestamps too far in the future or too far in the past are properly adjusted to five days in the past before being added to addrman.
